original_prompt.global_prompt: Eight five-second shots preserve the doorway movement, the older man's turn, the ponytailed man's smile, the group repositioning, and alternating close views of restrained gestures and watchful expressions.

shots.text: Beside the entrance of a martial arts training room, the White-clad man, with short dark hair, a loose white uniform and dark belt, is hunched close to a pale wall with both hands raised. He drops downward out of the bottom of the view. Hold on the vacated wall, its rectangular switch plate and cropped red-and-black poster, with the doorway at right and horizontal bands of light across the surface. Keep the framing steady and the landing outside the view.

The Older man stands near the training room's poster wall in warm striped light. He has a balding crown, swept-back gray hair, a white mustache and pointed beard, and wears an olive-khaki collared shirt. In a close head-and-shoulders view, he turns from facing away through profile until his face is nearly frontal, then settles with a composed, attentive expression.

The Ponytailed man, a lean man with slicked-back dark hair tied at the nape and a black martial arts uniform, stands in the training room with his shoulders angled toward screen right. He keeps a slight open-mouthed smile, subtly adjusts his head and shoulders, and continues looking to the right. Warm angular light falls across the pale wall above the softly blurred mirrors behind him.

A wide view from the training room entrance shows the Older man standing centrally with his back toward us, in a khaki shirt and trousers with dark shoes. Facing him are the barefoot Ponytailed man at left and the Sleeveless man at right, a muscular man with short tousled light-brown hair and a sleeveless black uniform. Both men in black briefly bend forward and straighten. The Ponytailed man spreads his feet and raises his hands into a guard as the Sleeveless man steps inward behind the Older man's silhouette. On the burgundy floor in the right foreground, the White-clad man stays lying beside the doorway with one arm extended. Pale mats lead toward a rear mirror wall and open ladder beneath an American flag; dark window blinds line the right wall.

Seen over the Older man's khaki-clad back in the mirrored training room, the Sleeveless man steps into the center beside the Ponytailed man. He extends an open hand sideways toward his companion and holds it there while facing the Older man, his mouth moving slightly. The Ponytailed man keeps a bent, guarded posture with one hand near his chest and briefly glances toward the Sleeveless man. Warm light patterns remain above the mirrors.

Against the training room's pale poster wall, the Older man watches upward with a steady, restrained expression. The Sleeveless man's bare arm crosses the near foreground, briefly obscuring part of his face and chest, then lowers away from the center. The Older man remains composed, his khaki shirt pocket now visible with a pale rectangular item and pens.

In a close view inside the training room, the Sleeveless man fixes an intense gaze on the Older man, whose gray head and khaki shoulder occupy the right foreground edge. He raises both closed fists beside his cheeks and settles into a compact guard, maintaining a tight, serious expression. The American flag is softly blurred behind him. Hold the guard without beginning a strike.

The Older man holds a calm, attentive upward gaze in a steady close-up, his white mustache and pointed beard clearly visible above his khaki collar. The Sleeveless man's raised bare arm stays softly cropped at the upper-left edge, preserving their facing positions. Against the pale wall and red-and-black poster, the Older man makes only slight natural facial adjustments while maintaining his composed posture.
